button.name: action_calculate_parking_installment

button.name: action_operation_manager_approve
button.invisible: state not in ['pending_approvals'] or not finance_user_approve or not finance_approve or not manager_approve

button.name: action_generate_commissions
button.help: Create missing sales commissions and broker/ambassador claims based on the collection, and log the reasons for anything skipped in the chatter

button.name: action_change_ownership
button.invisible: not signed_by_client and state not in ['signed_client','operation_review','finance_review','top_management','signed_ceo','ready_to_deliver_contract','delivered_contract','ready_to_deliver','delivered']

field.name: agent_commission_ids
field.invisible: not split_commission_with_agents or referred_by not in ('broker', 'ambassador')

button.name: action_mark_fully_paid
button.confirm: This installment already has a payment. Mark it as fully paid (the rest is counted as settled outside the system)?

button.name: make_cheque_payment
button.invisible: remaining_amount <= 0 or parent.state in ['cancelled'] or parent.contract_type == 'domestic'

button.name: action_create_payment

button.name: action_create_cheque
button.invisible: remaining_amount <= 0 or parent.state in ['cancelled'] or parent.contract_type == 'domestic'
